retained_cases: None of these and bare None are invariant to candidate order.
Letters naming algebraic variables, geometric points, events or entities are not answer-label references.
Roman numerals referring to explicitly numbered statements in the unchanged question are retained.
First, second and other ordinal words describing events or passage content are retained.
The above substring in an email address or a stem referring to the supplied passage is not an option-order reference.
